0:
data_dir: /var/lib/vector
sources:
  talos_service:
    type: socket
    mode: udp
    address: 127.0.0.1:6050
    receive_buffer_bytes: 8388608
    decoding:
      codec: json
  talos_kernel:
    type: socket
    mode: udp
    address: 127.0.0.1:6051
    receive_buffer_bytes: 8388608
    decoding:
      codec: json
transforms:
  drop_kernel_copy:
    type: filter
    inputs: [talos_service]
    condition: '."talos-service" != "kernel"'
  talos:
    type: remap
    inputs: [drop_kernel_copy, talos_kernel]
    source: |
      .node = get_env_var("NODE_NAME") ?? "unknown"
      svc = del(."talos-service")
      .service = if is_null(svc) { "kernel" } else { svc }
      if exists(."talos-level") { .level = del(."talos-level") }
      .timestamp = parse_timestamp(del(."talos-time"), "%+") ?? now()
      del(.host)
      del(.port)
      del(.source_type)
  # delta and epsilon run SELinux in permissive mode (the other
  # nodes never load it) and log every would-be denial: ~194k
  # audit record lines/h, mostly pod writes to unlabeled volumes.
  # Nothing is enforced, so drop the records; the kernel's
  # "audit: rate limit exceeded" summaries still come through.
  drop_audit:
    type: filter
    inputs: [talos]
    condition: '!match(to_string(.msg) ?? "", r''^type=(AVC|USER_AVC|SYSCALL|PATH|PROCTITLE|CWD|EOE|SOCKADDR|MAC_STATUS|BPF) '')'
  # The Talos console dashboard polls machined over localhost with
  # the same 10 read-only calls, and each call logs an authz line
  # plus an OK line: ~14k lines/h per node. Drop those calls and
  # successful authz lines; other methods' OK lines (apply-config,
  # reboot, ...) still come through as the audit trail.
  drop_dashboard_polls:
    type: filter
    inputs: [drop_audit]
    condition: |
      msg = to_string(.msg) ?? ""
      authz = match(msg, r'machined/authz/authorizer authorized \(')
      poll = match(msg, r'machined OK \[/machine\.MachineService/(Version|SystemStat|ServiceList|Processes|NetworkDeviceStats|Memory|LoadAvg|DiskStats|CPUInfo|CPUFreqStats)\] \S+ unary Success')
      !(.service == "machined" && (authz || poll))
sinks:
  loki:
    type: loki
    inputs: [drop_dashboard_polls]
    endpoint: http://loki.monitoring.svc.cluster.local:3100
    encoding:
      codec: json
      except_fields: [node, service, timestamp]
    # app-template runs this through Helm tpl, so Vector's braces are escaped.
    labels:
      job: talos
      node: '{{ "{{" }} node }}'
      service: '{{ "{{" }} service }}'
    out_of_order_action: accept

group: towonel
path: /v1/health
client:
  dns-resolver: udp://1.1.1.1:53
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 200"
  - "[BODY].status == ok"

group: towonel
url: http://vps.clerici.tech
client:
  ignore-redirect: true
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 301"

group: towonel
url: https://vps.clerici.tech:8444/healthz
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 200"
  - "[BODY].status == ok"

enable_quic_addr_discovery = true
http_bind_addr = "[::]:8080"
metrics_bind_addr = "[::]:9095"

[tls]
hostname = "vps.clerici.tech"
cert_mode = "Reloading"
manual_cert_path = "/tls/tls.crt"
manual_key_path = "/tls/tls.key"
https_bind_addr = "[::]:8444"
quic_bind_addr = "[::]:7842"

# Parsed but NOT implemented as of iroh-relay v1.4.1
[limits]
accept_conn_limit = 5.0
accept_conn_burst = 50

set -e
# the kubelet auto-creates a missing file-subPath as a directory;
# remove any such stale dir from earlier runs before seeding
if [ -e /seed/config.json ] && [ ! -f /seed/config.json ]; then
  rm -rf /seed/config.json
fi
if [ ! -f /seed/config.json ]; then
  if [ -f /seed/data/config.json ]; then
    # migrate from the previous layout where config.json lived under data/
    cp /seed/data/config.json /seed/config.json
  else
    cp /app/defaultConfig.json /seed/config.json
  fi
fi

alias ocs='octoprint config set'
ocs --json server.reverseProxy.trustedProxies '["${CLUSTER_POD_CIDR}"]'
ocs webcam.ffmpeg /usr/bin/ffmpeg
ocs plugins.classicwebcam.snapshot "http://octoprint-go2rtc:1984/api/frame.jpeg?src=printer"
ocs plugins.classicwebcam.stream "https://printer-cam.clerici.tech/api/stream.mjpeg?src=printer"
ocs serial.port /dev/serial/by-id/usb-1a86_USB_Serial-if00-port0
ocs --bool plugins.tracking.enabled false

while read -r user key; do
  [ -n "$user" ] || continue
  echo "=== syncing $user"
  JPW_SERVER_TOKENS="{\"raphael\": \"$RAPHAEL_API_KEY\", \"silo\": \"$key\"}" \
    JPW_WHITELIST_USERS="[\"$user\"]" python -u main.py </dev/null
done <<EOF
$SILO_USERS
EOF

dryrun: false
debug_level: INFO
run_only_once: true
# RO root fs
log_file: /tmp/log.log
mark_file: /tmp/mark.log
request_timeout: 300
max_threads: 1
# Raphael's copies are separate arr grabs, so filenames never match
generate_guids: true
generate_locations: false
whitelist_libraries: [Movies, tv]
library_mappings:
  - canonical: tv
    aliases:
      - {server: raphael, library: TV Shows}
      - {server: silo, library: TV}
jellyfin:
  - name: raphael
    baseurl: http://jellyfin:8096
    sync_to: [silo]
  - name: silo
    baseurl: https://jellyfin.clerici.tech
    sync_to: [raphael]
